failed_fixture.cause: The fixture wrapped write(), but this pinned UnixStream::write uses send_with_flags(..., MSG_NOSIGNAL). No pressure was injected; retirement_requested was false.

limitations: Startup checks the observed process-wide glibc System baseline at two boundaries. Observations are non-atomic and do not bound later allocation growth, fragmentation, direct mappings, other threads or complete RSS.

GNU/Linux stream workers now require mallinfo2 at runtime for this public startup path; the library still has no direct link dependency on that symbol. Other platforms/configurations are not qualified by this gate.
Caller/driver activity after an observation still needs its own lifetime reservation and enforcement. Ordinary workload admission remains closed for incomplete profiles.

The pressure hook is compiled only into the qualification C executable, using the pinned UnixStream send implementation and READY framing. Production allocator settings and protocol bytes are unchanged.

All maintained proving families/routes, broader/live-cache workloads, five matched throughput pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64/deadline/depth/size gates, multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and newer Apple source integration remain open.
